output.reason: The only evidence, [ev-ddf5fd344d03], says Consul support "has been removed". It does not say what happens to an environment that still has Consul configured. It could fail to start, ignore the setting or reject the configuration, and the surrounding 1.17 Upgrade Notes add nothing about Consul. The proposed workload-failure statement ("will fail to function", "state synchronization") goes beyond the text, and this would put mandatory work on environments without support. We need upstream text that says how the agent behaves when Consul is still configured (for example, the kvstore option being rejected at startup or ignored).
